Repo: /Users/marklevison/Documents/GitHub/expnese-tracker-attempts/yfl-expense-tracker-svelte-generated

TASK: The per-file batch-upload isolation logic (spec upr2a) lives inline in `src/routes/receipts/+page.svelte` in the `onFilesChanged` handler and is untested. Extract the orchestration into a testable pure-ish function and add unit tests.

Steps:
1. Read `src/routes/receipts/+page.svelte`, function `onFilesChanged` (and related state: the `uploading` flag, the per-file try/catch, the multi-line error summary it builds, and the file-input `value` reset). Understand exactly what it does today — that is the source of truth.
2. Create `src/lib/utils/batchUpload.ts` exporting a pure orchestration helper, e.g. `processUploadBatch(files, uploadOne, hooks?)` where `uploadOne(file) => Promise<result>` is an INJECTED dependency (so tests don't touch storage/Mistral). It must reproduce the current behavior:
   - iterate all files, isolating each in try/catch so one failure does NOT abort the rest;
   - accumulate a per-file error summary (the same message shape the page shows);
   - return a structured result (successes, failures/messages) the page can render.
   Do NOT change observable behavior — match the current handler.
3. Refactor `onFilesChanged` to call `processUploadBatch`, keeping the `uploading` flag transitions and `input.value = ''` reset in the component (those are DOM concerns; the extracted helper handles the loop + error aggregation). No duplicated loop logic left behind.
4. Add `src/lib/utils/batchUpload.spec.ts`: all files succeed; one file throws (others still processed, error captured in summary); multiple failures aggregated; empty list; error-summary message shape matches. Use an injected `uploadOne` mock — never call real upload/OCR.

Constraints (project conventions — follow exactly):
- Vitest. TYPED — no `any`/`as any` except last-resort with inline reason.
- Tests must never call Mistral/OCR/storage — everything injected/mocked.
- Code style: tabs, single quotes, no trailing commas, 100-char width.
- Clear pre-existing lint/type warnings in files you touch.
- Do NOT `git commit`. Do NOT run repo-wide prettier — only `npx prettier --write` on changed files.

VERIFY before returning: run `npm run test:unit -- src/lib/utils/batchUpload.spec.ts`; run `npm run check` and confirm no new errors in the files you touched. Report the helper API, how the page consumes it, and final pass counts.

## Summary

Extracted the untested per-file batch-upload isolation logic (spec upr2a) out of the `onFilesChanged` handler into a testable, dependency-injected helper.

### Helper API — `src/lib/utils/batchUpload.ts`
```ts
processUploadBatch<T>(
  files: Iterable<File>,
  uploadOne: (file: File) => Promise<T>,   // injected — no storage/OCR here
  hooks?: { onSuccess?: (result: T, file: File) => void; onError?: (file: File, error: unknown) => void }
): Promise<{ successes: T[]; failures: string[]; errorMessage: string | null }>
```
- Iterates all files, isolating each in its own try/catch so one failure never aborts the batch.
- Per-file failure messages keep the original shape `"<name>: <reason>"` (reason = `err.message` or the `'Failed to upload'` fallback for non-Error throws).
- `errorMessage` reproduces the exact summary: `` `Failed ${n} of ${total} receipt(s):\n${failures.join('\n')}` `` when any fail, else `null`.

### How the page consumes it — `src/routes/receipts/+page.svelte`
`onFilesChanged` still owns the DOM concerns (the `uploading` flag transitions and `input.value = ''` reset). It now delegates the loop + aggregation:
- `uploadOne` = `(file) => receiptService.uploadAndCreate(file)`
- `onSuccess` prepends each receipt (`allReceipts = [receipt, ...allReceipts]`) in file order — identical to the old inline loop.
- `onError` does the `console.error(...)` logging.
- `error = errorMessage` (null when nothing failed, matching the prior behavior where `error` was pre-set to null). No duplicated loop logic remains.

Behavior is unchanged; the moved console.error is now an injected hook so tests stay silent.

### Tests — `src/lib/utils/batchUpload.spec.ts` (7 tests, all injected mocks)
All succeed (order preserved) · onSuccess ordering · single failure isolated (others still processed, captured in summary) · onError receives failing file + thrown value · multiple failures aggregated into the multi-line summary · non-Error fallback reason · empty list (no-op, null errorMessage).

### Verification
- `npm run test:unit -- src/lib/utils/batchUpload.spec.ts` → 7 passed / 7 (server project).
- `npm run check` → 0 errors, 0 warnings.
- `eslint` on all three touched files → clean. Prettier-formatted (typed throughout, no `any`).

Note: I did not follow the dead `#{#id}` spec-tag convention (per project memory the spec system is abandoned); the extracted code uses plain comments referencing spec upr2a.
